finding.basis: Source review and literal CPU reproduction, not Native performance.
finding.description: Zero rollout calls do not remove the artificial solver wait: fixed_action returns the solver window's future first_action_at and applies the MPC solver-only deadline to Fixed.
finding.consequence: Fixed can be delayed or refused even when its real action deadline and source freshness remain valid, biasing a comparison.
finding.required_fix: Fixed must be immediately applicable without a model-solver wait or solver-only expiry. Preserve real entry/action deadline, identity, clock, ledger, source freshness and CAS requirements; leave MPC/OneMove guards unchanged.

other_limitations: freeze_fixed chooses a model-ranked training reference, not an empirically strongest GPU Fixed baseline.
Typed scenario provenance and hashes are declarations, not proof of no evaluation leakage.
Read-state callbacks are injected, not implemented concurrent HTTP observation.
No CPU result qualifies real actuation, Native prediction or a complete loop.
